stemMd: A horizontal 18 N force pulls a 4 kg block against 6 N of friction. What is its acceleration?
explanationMd: The net horizontal force is 18−6=12 N. Newton's second law gives acceleration 12/4=3 m/s squared, in the direction of the applied force.

distractorRationale.e: This uses friction alone as the driving force.
distractorRationale.d: This adds friction to the applied force.
distractorRationale.c: This uses net force as acceleration without dividing by mass.
